title: Driver and Vehicle Owner Affiliation Agreement
intro: This Agreement is entered into between Giftwako Travel (Pty) Ltd (hereinafter referred to as "the Company") and the undersigned Vehicle Owner / Driver (hereinafter referred to as "the Affiliate"). This Agreement is divided into two parts – Part A and Part B. Both parts are binding on the Company and the Affiliate.

part_a.heading: Part A – Company's details
company_details: Physical address: Gerrit Kruger St 17, Aqua Park, Tzaneen 0838
part_a.affiliate_note: Part A also records the Vehicle Owner's and Driver's details (owner name and ID number, driver name and ID number, licence code and PrDP, contact numbers, physical address, vehicle registration, make/model/year, seating capacity and roadworthy status). These details are captured from your registration form.

vision: You are not just joining with your car. You are becoming a founding transport partner of a national brand. We are building a network from Bolobedu to Cape Town. When Giftwako grows, you grow.

sections.heading: 1. Purpose of Agreement
clauses: The Owner agrees to affiliate his/her vehicle and/or driver to Giftwako Travel (Pty) Ltd to provide professional transport services under the Giftwako Travel brand.

sections.heading: 2. Relationship of parties
clauses: a) The Owner/Driver is an independent contractor, not an employee of Giftwako Travel.
b) The Owner is responsible for hiring and paying his/her own driver, if the owner is not the driver.
c) The Company will source clients and book and allocate trips to affiliated vehicles.

sections.heading: 3. Benefits of joining Giftwako Travel
clauses: a) Free marketing & clients – We advertise on Google, Facebook and our website www.giftwakotravel.co.za. You don't pay for marketing; we bring clients to you.
b) Professional system – No more fighting for clients on the street. We handle quotations, bookings and invoicing professionally.
c) Driver & business training – Free online training on customer service, tourism and how to get 5-star reviews.
d) Company branding support – Your car will be listed as an approved Giftwako vehicle, increasing trust with clients. We will provide Giftwako stickers and driver ID cards.
e) Fair payment system – All money is collected by the Company for safety, then paid to you 24–48 hours after trip completion. No delays.
f) Insurance and safety support – We only allocate trips that are verified. We assist with route planning and client verification.

sections.heading: 4. Owner responsibilities
clauses: a) Ensure the vehicle is always roadworthy and licensed, that the driver holds a Professional Driving Permit (PrDP) and is of sober habits.
b) The owner/driver is fully responsible for all vehicle costs: fuel, maintenance, tyres, insurance and traffic fines.
c) The vehicle may not be used to solicit clients directly to bypass the Company.
d) No private deals with Giftwako clients behind the Company.
e) If you, as owner or driver, get a new client or referral, you must not take cash from them directly. You must refer them to book online at www.giftwakotravel.co.za and pay online.
f) This helps us grow the Company system, track income and give you more trips. The more bookings on the system, the more income we all receive.
g) Commission will still be paid to you even if the client booked online, so there is no need to bypass the system.

sections.heading: 5. Kilometre-based billing system
clauses: a) Our official system charges clients per kilometre. This is transparent and fair.
b) The rate per kilometre is set by Management and updated on the website. No driver is allowed to overcharge or undercharge. You must follow the system quote.
c) Every trip must be verified by kilometre reading before departure and after arrival.

sections.heading: 6. Zero tolerance for bullying and sexual harassment – R2 300 fine
clauses: Giftwako Travel has zero tolerance for customer harassment, bullying, insulting, sexual harassment or unwanted touching.

If a driver bullies, insults, harasses or sexually harasses/touches a client: (a) an immediate disciplinary fine of R2 300.00 will be imposed on the driver/owner; (b) the fine must be paid within 3 days (72 hours); (c) if you fail to pay within 3 days, we will take legal action, report to SAPS, and you will be permanently terminated and blacklisted; (d) the client has the right to open a criminal case under the Criminal Law (Sexual Offences and Related Matters) Amendment Act 32 of 2007 and the Protection from Harassment Act 17 of 2011.
No harassment will be tolerated towards customers. We protect our clients.

sections.heading: 7. Protection of drivers and owners against false accusations
clauses: Giftwako Travel (Pty) Ltd is committed to protecting its clients, but also to protecting its drivers and vehicle owners from false, malicious or dishonest reports made by clients to get free trips or refunds, or to damage the Company's reputation.

sections.heading: 8. Presumption of innocence and fair investigation
clauses: a) When a client reports a driver/owner for harassment, bullying, theft, recklessness or any misconduct, the Company will not immediately terminate the driver.

b) The driver/owner will be given 48 hours to provide his/her side of the story in writing or via recorded call. This is in line with section 33 of the Constitution of South Africa (right to just administrative action) and the principles of natural justice (audi alteram partem – hear the other side).

sections.heading: 9. Evidence and investigation procedure
clauses: To protect both sides, Management will: (a) request evidence such as trip GPS, dashcam footage (if available), WhatsApp messages, booking records and witness statements from other passengers; (b) interview both the client and the driver separately; (c) where possible, review in-vehicle camera or tracking logs.
All drivers are strongly advised to install a dashcam for their own protection.

sections.heading: 10. If a client is found to be lying
clauses: a) The client will be immediately and permanently blacklisted from using Giftwako Travel services.
b) The client will forfeit any refund or security deposit.
c) The Company will issue a formal letter of demand for defamation against the client.
d) Legal action – the driver/owner has the right to open a case against the client under South African law (criminal law; civil law – defamation; Protection from Harassment Act 17 of 2011).
e) Giftwako Travel Management will provide a written clearance letter to the driver/owner stating that he/she was found not guilty, to protect his/her reputation.

sections.heading: 11. Protection of Company reputation
clauses: If a client spreads lies on social media (Facebook, WhatsApp groups), the Company will take action under section 19 of the Cybercrimes Act 19 of 2020 (malicious communications) and demand removal of the post within 24 hours.

sections.heading: 12. Our commitment
clauses: Giftwako Travel will never sacrifice a loyal driver/owner for a lying client. We protect our drivers as much as we protect our clients. Truth comes first.

sections.heading: 13. Driver's code of conduct
clauses: a) Be punctual, respectful, sober and professionally dressed.
b) Follow the official itinerary from Management.
c) Report any breakdown or accident immediately.
d) Never ask a client for extra money – all payments go through the office.

sections.heading: 14. Company responsibilities
clauses: a) To market the business and provide clients/trips.
b) To handle all bookings, quotations and client payments.
c) To provide training via calls/online sessions.
d) To manage the payment split as agreed.
e) To promote top-performing owners/drivers.

sections.heading: 15. Payment terms
clauses: All client payments will be received by Giftwako Travel. The Company will pay the owner/driver as per the agreed commission structure per trip.

sections.heading: 16. Duration and termination
clauses: This Agreement is valid from the date of signature. Either party may terminate with 14 days' written notice.

acceptance: Declaration: I, the undersigned, have read, understand and agree to all terms and conditions of this Agreement. Ticking "I have read and agree" on the registration form constitutes your acceptance of this Agreement; a signed copy of the PDF may additionally be requested by Management.
